entity.name: Matthew Busel / Tensorust LLC
entity.description: Tensorust LLC is a New York company owned and run by Matthew Busel, who writes and maintains its open source libraries: fin-primitives (exact-decimal trading indicators for Rust and Python), llm-prices (a dated, source-cited LLM API price table), us-restricted-parties (US restricted-party lists as daily machine-readable releases) and sbom-attest (build-time SBOMs and provenance for Rust and C/C++). Funding pays for maintainer time: releases, bug fixes, security work, documentation and keeping data current. More at https://tensorust.com

projects.name: us-restricted-parties
projects.description: DoD 1260H, Section 889, FCC Covered List, UFLPA and BIOSECURE lists rebuilt daily from the official sources and published as pinned, hash-checked releases in Senzing JSON Lines. Includes a standard-library-only Python loader and a Go package, and works with moov-io/watchman for screening. Code is MIT; the data release is CC BY 4.0.

plans.name: Sponsor the maintainer
